Hymn 333: High on the Mountain Top
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: F Major
Composer: Ebenezer Beesley
Lyricist/Text Author: Joel H. Johnson
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 333 titled "High on the Mountain Top" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in F Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Ebenezer Beesley and the lyrics were written by Joel H. Johnson.
